package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// StudentOnboardingRepository owns the student's declared learning profile.
type StudentOnboardingRepository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, profile domain.StudentOnboarding, expectedVersion int64) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error)
}

// LearnerOverviewMasteryReader returns bounded current projections, never raw evidence.
type LearnerOverviewMasteryReader interface {
	ListRecentStudentTargetMastery(ctx context.Context, studentID string, limit int) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error)
}
